summary: St. Joe NF L-4 cab on a spur near Ward Peak, Shoshone County: built in the 1930s, destroyed in the 1960s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists type Ground, status Gone; Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in the 1960s

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site Hike-In; no access details given

events.note: L-4 cab atop spur, dated only to the 1930s by sources

Sources say only 'the 1960s' (Firelookout.com: Destroyed 1960s; Idaho Fire Lookouts: 1960's Destroyed); no source gives 1960, so 1960 is a placeholder for that decade, as 1930 is for the 1930s elsewhere in this record. The story says 1960s, per the corrections entry

evidence.supports: L-4 cab atop spur about 3/4 mile SSE of Ward Peak, built in the 1930s
evidence.quote: 1930s: L-4 cab atop spur 3/4 mile SSE of Ward Peak. Destroyed 1960s.

evidence.supports: sources give decades only, no exact year for build or destruction
on the St. Joe National Forest
listed with type Ground and status Gone

corrections.why: Both pages date the destruction to the 1960s without naming a year; 1960 is not stated in either source

notes_for_editor: Brief record said destroyed 1960; sources say the 1960s. Built date is 1930s only. Firelookout.com credits a photo to Alvin Friedland but gives no image URL, so no photos entry. Shoshone County Forest Lookouts page on idaholookouts.weebly.com has a State Line entry, but the cached text gives no dates, so it is not cited. Nothing found on staffing, fires or current site condition.
